issues.on_page: Sales 5,870,371 (enterprise funds Total: Electric, Water, Sewer, Trash, Landfill)
issues.issue: [fixed 2026-10-28: enterprise Sales 5,870,371 recategorized to Utility Charges] Utility fund sales have their own receipt category under the user's rules (Utility Charges: utility fund sales/charges/collections, garbage/refuse). Charges for services/fees is no longer the category for these lines.

issues.on_page: Charges for services 457,491 = Golf Fund 415,681 + General Fund 41,810 (Pool 14,365, Library 4,370, Cemetery 23,075; p22-23)
issues.issue: About 91% of the line is golf course fees, which have their own category, Recreation Fees, under the user's rules. The same applies in detail: Golf and Pool charges (detail[96], detail[21]) could be Recreation Fees and Cemetery charges (detail[34]) could be Cemetery Fees. The printed label itself says charges for services, so this is left as a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Cemetery department expenditures 187,954 (statement counts them under Public works)
issues.issue: Cemetery spending is normally health/welfare. The extractor used streets/highways (all ten Cemetery lines, detail[106]-detail[115]) so the lines tie to the statement's Public works column. This is defensible but questionable, and the statement-level Public works line 736,839 also carries the cemetery.
